Do I need an account to use FridgeVista?
No. Core inventory, shopping lists, expiration tracking, and local reminders work without an account. Hosted AI, recipe search, photo analysis, and subscriptions require sign-in.

不注册账号，能用到什么程度？
记录库存、整理购物清单、查看保质期和设置本机提醒都没问题。云端 AI、菜谱搜索、照片识别和订阅需要登录。

Does my pantry sync between devices?
Not currently. Inventory is stored locally on the device. Keeping guest data on-device is part of the privacy-first design.

换手机后，库存会自己跟过去吗？
暂时不会。当前版本的厨房数据保存在原来那台设备上。

What happens to my data if I use guest mode?
Guest inventory stays in local app storage. Clearing app data or uninstalling the app can permanently remove it, and FridgeVista cannot restore it from a server.

游客模式下的数据会怎样处理？
游客模式下的库存数据保存在本机应用中。清除应用数据或卸载应用，可能导致这些数据永久丢失。由于数据不会上传到服务器，FridgeVista 无法为你恢复。

Where can I get help?
Visit the help center to browse common answers or send a private support request.

碰到问题，去哪里问？
前往帮助中心。可以先找答案，也可以直接发一个私密支持请求。

How quickly will I receive a reply?
FridgeVista is supported by a small team. We cannot promise a reply to every message, but privacy and account-deletion requests are always handled.

多久会回复？
FridgeVista 由小团队提供支持。我们无法保证回复每一条消息，但会妥善处理所有隐私及账号删除请求。

Can I get support without an account?
Yes. Guest users can submit a request using any email address where they want to receive a reply. Enter N/A when the form asks for an account email.

没账号也能提问吗？
只需填写一个能够接收回复的邮箱；如果没有 FridgeVista 账号，请在账号邮箱栏填写“不适用”。

Should I ask for account deletion here?
Deleting from the app is faster: open Settings > Account > Delete account. Use the request form if you cannot sign in or the in-app option does not work.

想删账号，要在这里申请吗？
能进入应用时，请在设置 > 账号 > 删除账号中操作。如果无法登录或应用内删除功能不可用，请提交支持请求。

What should I remove from screenshots?
Hide email addresses, names, passwords, API keys, payment details, and any other sensitive information before attaching an image.

截图里要遮掉什么？
请遮挡邮箱地址、姓名、密码、API 密钥、付款信息及其他敏感个人信息。

Where do subscriptions get canceled?
Manage subscriptions through Apple in iOS Settings or inside FridgeVista under Settings > Plan & Usage. Deleting a FridgeVista account does not cancel an App Store subscription.

订阅去哪里取消？
前往 iOS 设置中的 Apple 账户 > 订阅，或在应用内打开“设置 > 计划与用量”管理订阅。删除 FridgeVista 账号不会取消 App Store 订阅。
